name: Tyrone Marhguy
tagline: Discrete transistors to tapeout — and the software that ships with them.
bio: Building computers from discrete transistors to tapeout — and the software to test, automate, and deploy them. Designing a 32-bit CPU; contributor to OpenFPGA and Verilator; previously full-custom SRAM, market-data parsers, and a local dev toolbox.
hardwareTrack: RTL, FPGA, and ASIC tapeouts — discrete logic through silicon.
softwareTrack: Production backends, embedded firmware, and tooling.
